_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decentraland/social-service-ea/main/src/controllers/handlers/http/create-community-handler.ts (createCommunityHandler multipart field set: formData.files.thumbnail + formData.fields {name, description, placeIds, privacy, visibility}) + https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decentraland/social-service-ea/main/src/logic/community/fields-validator.ts (name<=30 non-empty, description<=500 non-empty, thumbnail image 1KB..500KB, privacy CommunityPrivacyEnum, visibility CommunityVisibilityEnum) + https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decentraland/social-service-ea/main/src/logic/community/types.ts (CommunityPrivacyEnum public|private, CommunityVisibilityEnum all|unlisted). NAME-gate from catalyst:/lambdas/profiles/{address} avatars[].name + hasClaimedName. Cross-checked against the local crate catalyrst/crates/catalyrst-communities: src/fed/messages.rs (CommunityCreate { name, description, private, unlisted, flags }), src/handlers/writes.rs create_community (require_owned_name gate — owner must hold a claimed DCL name, else NotAuthorized).
_notes: catalyrst-communities EXISTS in the workspace (writes::create_community) but the route is NOT proxied on the public edge: GET https://catalyst.example.com/social/v1/communities and /v1/communities both 404 (probed 2026-06-23). POST /v1/communities additionally requires a DCL auth-chain signature AND a held DCL NAME (require_owned_name), so an anonymous in-client overlay session is fail-closed. This is the bevy-overlay (in-client HUD) variant of community creation: the CreateOrEditCommunityPanel modal renders over the dimmed Communities directory. Flow / states / field validation / telemetry are REAL; the final create_community POST is SIMULATED (deterministic stand-in id mirroring community_id_hex). The discoverability toggle maps to upstream `visibility` (on -> all/listed, off -> unlisted). Membership maps to upstream `privacy` (public/private). The GetNamePanel gate mirrors CommunityCreate.jsx + the server require_owned_name gate; it is SKIPPED when the session already owns a NAME (see `name`).

name.upstream: catalyst:/lambdas/profiles/{address} -> avatars[0].name + hasClaimedName; require_owned_name in writes.rs. Empty here (anonymous overlay session): the NAME gate is shown. Override with ?owned=1 to simulate a session that already holds a NAME (gate skipped).
